limitations: view_lift is unbounded below at -1 and unbounded above; extreme creators with very few videos can produce large swings. The analysis-ready corpus is not a random sample of the niche: deep.py only ever processed reels that score.py had already ranked near the top of their creator's output, so its median robust_z is above zero by construction. Any contrast computed inside it compares strong videos with other strong videos, not strong with average (docs/M2RADAR_ANALYSIS_METHOD.md §1.4).
method: Histogram (40 bins) of view_lift across every ingested code with a creator median; y-axis log-scaled because the count itself is heavy-tailed.
title: Video performance ratio distribution (view_lift)
